[Guillaume Knight]
The objective of the Flavius Battle is to score 2 points before your enemy by destroying their crystal.

[Guillaume Knight]
The crystals for both armies are protected by special barricades that cannot be destroyed by direct attacks.

[Guillaume Knight]
But they can be removed by destroying the Guardians that protect the enemy army base.

[Guillaume Knight]
The crystals are immune to every type of skill; your physical attacks are the only choice for destroying your enemy's crystal.

[Guillaume Knight]
If you are ready, start by clicking the ^0000FFbattle button from the interface^000000.

[Guillaume Knight]
Please remember: when you join a battle, you will be receiving a token which indicates the set duration for which you cannot participate in the same type of battle.
You may check the duration by pressing the Alt+U keys.

[Guillaume Knight]
Please bear in mind once you cancel, ^0000FFyou may not reapply for 1 minute^000000!

[Guillaume Knight]
Are you ready for battle? Then apply with the recruiter next to me!
